classification.difficultyReason: Equal distances from the centre give equal chords. Then the perpendicular bisects the chord, so x is half of 30.

answer.worked:
The chords are each $8\text{ cm}$ from the centre, so they are equal in length.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Lower chord}&=30\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord.
$$\begin{align*}x&=\frac{30}{2}\\&=15\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
